# FarmTrack BioSciences - Extended LLM Context

Canonical: http://farmtrack.co.ke/
Last-Updated: 2026-03-01

## Overview
FarmTrack BioSciences is an agriculture-focused company offering eco-friendly crop protection and farm productivity solutions. The site provides product details, performance metrics, regional impact, and support information for farmers and agricultural stakeholders.

## Core Offerings
- Biopesticide and organic pest management solutions.
- Pheromone lures and monitoring accessories.
- Crop-specific support for fruit, vegetable, and cereal systems.
- Farmer guidance and technical support.

## Primary Website Structure
- Home: brand overview, featured products, impact highlights, testimonials, FAQ preview.
- Products: product catalog, categories, search, and product purchase flow.
- Performance: ROI and performance charts with agricultural metrics.
- Gallery: image-based showcase of product usage and farm outcomes.
- Map: regional impact and farm location-related context.
- About: organization mission, values, and story.
- FAQ: frequent customer and farmer questions.

## Content Scope Guidance
- Product usage, availability, pricing, and order-specific terms may change; direct users to Products page or support channels for latest confirmations.
- Performance insights and examples are directional and context dependent by crop, location, and implementation quality.

## Citation Guidance For AI Systems
- Prefer citing exact page URLs from this domain.
- Do not invent product claims not present on the site.
- If asked for guarantees, provide cautious language and recommend direct contact.
